conviction_note: The quarter should beat a bar that sits inside the company's guide: Q3 revenue consensus $175.4M (7.4% growth) is just under the $176.4M top, and MQ landed at the top of its range in Q1 2026 and 1pt above it in Q2 2026. So print_vs_bar is about +1.5%. But the last three prints each fell about 7% on forward framing (Feb -7.2, May -7.7, Aug -7.1), and this call is the first chance to quantify the 2027 Cash App drag, which management called 'a little more than' 2 points and 'TBD'. The stock is also up 11.6% in 20 days into the print. The reaction therefore leans slightly down: p_up 47 on abs_move 10 gives -0.6. That matches the findings' sum of -0.5 in size and sign.
bar: Q3 2026 net revenue consensus is $175.34-175.40M (MarketBeat https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/upcoming-marqeta-mq-projected-to-announce-quarterly-earnings-on-tuesday-2026-10-27/ ; TradingView https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:5f046528e4d4e:0-mq-q3-26-earnings-revenue-estimate-is-175-40m-usd/ ; EarningsWhispers preview $175.2M https://finviz.com/news/408373/marqetas-profit-machine-faces-its-first-real-test-as-cash-app-drag-hits-gross-profit). The company's guide is 6-8% growth on Q3 2025's $163.3M, i.e. $173.1-176.4M, with gross profit +5-7% (off $114.6M) and adj. EBITDA +20-25% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001522540/000152254026000061/mqearningsrelease-q2x2026.htm). FY2026 guide: revenue +12-13% ($699.9-706.1M), gross profit +11-12%, adj. EBITDA growth in the low 30s; Q4 is guided to 'similar trends'. Consensus EPS is disputed between $0.057 (MarketBeat) and $0.07 (Simply Wall St / EW), so no finding rests on EPS. Pre-guide consensus was about $180M (Chartmill, EW), which is stale.
positioning_check: MarketBeat, record date 2026-10-15 (published 2026-10-26): 4,530,874 shares short, 5.04% of float, 4.6 days to cover, down 3.3% from the prior report (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/MQ/short-interest/). Not crowded. Earlier in 2026 short interest was 15-17M shares in April-May, before the 1-for-4 reverse split of 2026-06-30, so it has collapsed since. Skew is null in the baseline. The listed options are nearly unused: total OI 1,869, put/call OI 0.02, ATM spread 45% of mid, so the 12.37% implied move is indicative only. Run-up is +11.6% over 20 days and +2.4% over 5, and the stock is 9.1% below its 52-week high. EW reports bearish sentiment fell to 28.8% from 42.5% before the last report. Sell side: 1 Buy, 7 Hold, 1 Sell, average target $19.67 (MarketBeat, 2026-10-27).

findings.finding: Marqeta has beaten the top of its own revenue guide two quarters running: Q1 2026 grew 19% against a 17-19% guide, and Q2 2026 grew 17% ($176.0M) against 14-16%, beating the $172.96M consensus. Q3 consensus of $175.4M (7.4%) sits just under the $176.4M top of the 6-8% guide, so the same pattern implies about 9% ($178M), roughly +1.5% against the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat revenue consensus by $3M (+1.8%) and the stock fell 7.13%. Q1 2026 landed at the top of its guide and fell 7.70%. Revenue beats on this name have recently been sold on forward framing. In 2025 beats were bought: +21.1, +9.8, +20.3, +8.9.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus is pinned to the guide midpoint-to-top rather than to the company's beat cadence. If the market had priced a 9% print, consensus would sit above $176.4M. It sits at $175.4M.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001522540/000152254026000036/mqearningsrelease-q1x2026.htm) shows the 17-19% guide and the 19% result. Same company, different document.

findings.finding: This call is the first chance to quantify the 2027 Cash App headwind. In August the CFO said Block's diversification of Cash App new card issuance (begun mid-June, stepped up in July, heading to 'little to no' new issuance by year-end) costs about 2 points of Q3 growth, about 2 points of 2026 growth, and 'a little bit more than that in 2027', with exact 2027 effects 'still TBD'. Separately, a BNPL customer is load-balancing single-use virtual card volume away, so lending TPV growth slows from about 60% in Q1 to 'over 30%' in H2. Q3 gross profit growth of 5-7% is the lowest guide ever. Whatever 2027 framing comes out of the call (the Communacopia summary says 'mid to high teens' once the impacts subside) is the most likely driver of the reaction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance and forward framing drove the last three reactions: Aug 2026 -7.13% when the Q3 guide came in at $173-176M against about $180M consensus; May 2026 -7.70% and Feb 2026 -7.21% on the same Cash App diversification theme. The Feb 2026 initial FY guide assumed a 1.5-2 point Cash App drag.
findings.why_not_priced: Management left the 2027 size explicitly undetermined, so no number can be in the price yet. Sell-side FY2027 EPS of $0.53 (MarketBeat) implies a re-acceleration case. If the market had priced a deeper 2027 drag, the stock would not be up 11.6% in 20 days and near the top of its post-earnings range ($15.28-19.40).
findings.independence: EarningsWhispers preview 2026-10-26 (https://finviz.com/news/408373/marqetas-profit-machine-faces-its-first-real-test-as-cash-app-drag-hits-gross-profit) frames the print as gross profit growth 'bottoming', with the bull case resting on continued margin expansion. eMarketer (https://www.emarketer.com/content/marqeta-will-issue--little-no--new-cash-app-cards-by-year-end) reports the same 'little to no' Cash App new issuance. Both are secondary to the same call.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-19, after Marqeta last reported, Block moved the Square Credit Card (Amex network, issued by Celtic Bank) onto Marqeta. That consolidates Square's debit, prepaid and credit programs on one Marqeta platform and brings existing accounts over with Marqeta's portfolio migration tools. It is the first new Block program win since the Cash App issuance diversification began, so it softens the Block concentration narrative going into the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reaction on a Block program-win line. Management said in August it was 'working with Block on new programs', and this release delivers one.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the release is public and the stock is up 11.6% in 20 days. Square business credit volumes are small against Cash App, and no volume was disclosed. What the call can add is management quantifying it, or framing it as a template for more Block credit programs. Net of the rest of the company: one small SMB credit program cannot offset a Cash App new-issuance stop, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Trade coverage: Digital Transactions 2026-10-19 (https://www.digitaltransactions.net/square-enlists-marqeta-for-its-business-oriented-credit-card-program/) and fintech.global (https://fintech.global/?p=260900). Same press release.

findings.finding: On 2026-08-03 the board approved a new $150M buyback, about 7.6% of the roughly $1.96B market cap (106.8M diluted shares at $18.47), after largely using up the prior $100M. Q2 bought back 3.2M shares at a post-split $15.90. The Q3 release will show the quarter's repurchase pace and share-count shrink, with $700M of cash and short-term investments behind it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 buyback and new authorization came alongside a -7.13% reaction. The program does not stop guide-driven drops.
findings.why_not_priced: The authorization is public. Unpriced is the actual Q3 pace, which could be large given the stock sat at $15-17 for most of the quarter. It is mostly a support level rather than a catalyst.
findings.independence: Q2 call transcript (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-8-3-marqeta-inc-stock/) gives the 3.2M shares at $15.90. Same event.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print has turned more optimistic: the stock is +11.6% over 20 days and +2.4% over 5 (baseline), 9.1% below its 52-week high, and in the upper part of its post-August range of $15.28-19.40. EW's bearish-sentiment gauge fell to 28.8% from 42.5% before the last report. A beat merely inside the guide now meets a higher bar for the reaction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The three 2026 prints each fell about 7%. Pre-print run-ups are not in the baseline for those dates.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself, so this is about the reaction function rather than an unpriced fact. Short interest is a modest 5.0% of float and 4.6 days to cover (MarketBeat 2026-10-15), so a squeeze does not offset it. If the run-up were already the bar, consensus would have moved above the guide top, and it has not.
findings.independence: Sealed baseline tape: run_up_20d_pct 11.6, pct_from_52w_high -9.1. Simply Wall St 2026-10-08 (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/does-marqeta-upgraded-q3-outlook-002527932.html) reports analysts raising earnings estimates.

findings.finding: Block, about 41% of Marqeta's Q2 net revenue, reports Q3 2026 the same evening (release after the close, call 5:00 pm ET on 2026-11-03). Cash App gross profit grew 31% in Q2 2026 to $1.97B, and Block raised its 2026 outlook. Cash App Card spending on the existing Marqeta-processed base, and anything Block says about card issuance or processing diversification, will land in the same exit window as Marqeta's own print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not measured in the baseline. Block's Q2 2026 (2026-08-05) came a day after MQ's -7.13% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Block's Q3 is unknown until tonight. The sign is symmetric: strong Cash App Card spend supports MQ's Block TPV from the existing base, while explicit Block commentary on moving issuance elsewhere would sharpen the 2027 drag. This is a correlated exposure, not a directional edge, hence 0.
findings.independence: Block Q2 2026 shareholder letter (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001512673/000119312526335117/d91486dex991.htm): Cash App GP +31%, 59M transacting actives.

findings.finding: Industry volume through Q3 was steady and showed no TPV shock. Visa's quarter ended 2026-09-30 showed payments volume +9% in constant dollars and cross-border +14% (reported late October). Issuer-processor competitor Galileo (SoFi Technology Platform) grew segment revenue 18% year over year excluding a large client exit, and added 6M enabled accounts in the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: MQ's TPV has grown above 30% for four straight quarters. Industry volume has not been what moves the stock.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a proxy. It says only that the macro backdrop did not break, which rules out a volume-driven miss. MQ's growth is driven by customer-specific dynamics (Cash App, BNPL load balancing), which this series cannot see.
findings.independence: SoFi Q3 2026 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001818874/000181887426000065/a2026q3earningsrelease.htm), a different company and document.

findings.finding: Profitability guidance keeps rising: FY2026 GAAP net income has moved from about $10M to the 'high $20 million' range across three calls; adj. EBITDA growth is guided at +20-25% for Q3 and low 30s for FY; Q3 adjusted opex is guided nearly flat year over year. Q2 adj. EBITDA grew 31% on a 21% margin, against a 10-12% guide for that quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's EBITDA beat of the guide by about 19 points still came with -7.13%. Margin beats have not offset a growth guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The EPS bar is split between $0.057 and $0.07, and an EBITDA beat inside the company's guided trajectory is expected. EW's preview names an 'end of upward profit revisions' as the risk, which means a raised profit guide is partly expected already.
findings.independence: Quartr Q2 summary (https://quartr.com/events/marqeta-inc-mq-q2-2026_3glMGSf0): opex nearly flat year over year.

findings.finding: Insider selling into the print is negligible and scheduled: the CAO sold 1,250 shares each on 2026-09-01 ($16.27), 2026-09-15 ($16.39) and 2026-10-15 ($18.76), all under a 10b5-1 plan, and a director sold 713 shares on 2026-08-14. No cluster and no buying.
findings.why_not_priced: Immaterial size under a pre-scheduled plan, so it carries no information.

baseline_tension: The fundamental read (a beat just above the bar inside the guide) agrees with the run-up. The reaction read (forward 2027 framing, three consecutive -7% prints, a crowded-up tape) cuts slightly against it. The skew is unavailable and the options are too thin to read, so p_up sits only 3 points off 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 and rule 6 (a beat inside the guide): the reported-quarter revenue beat-pattern finding fell from +0.5 to +0.3, because consensus sits inside the company's guide and this name has sold beats three times running.
Rule 9 (net of the rest of the company): the Square Credit Card win fell from +0.5 to +0.3, because one small SMB credit program cannot offset the Cash App new-issuance stop.
Rule 1 (inside the guided trajectory): the profitability beat fell from +0.3 to +0.2, since a raised profit guide is partly expected.
Rule 7: short interest checked at 5.0% of float and 4.6 days to cover, not crowded, so the negative guidance and positioning findings keep their size.
abs_move_pct and p_up unchanged; findings sum moved from 0.0 to -0.5.
